title: The Sparky Points
summary: A trident that generates Lightning Charges on qualifying weapon damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Martial, versatile, thrown and dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Electric Blood: Gain 2 Lightning Charges when dealing damage with this weapon, once per attack roll. Throwing the trident does not qualify.
fields.Lightning Charges: While charged, +1 to attack rolls and +1 Lightning damage. At 5 charges, the next qualifying damage adds 1d8 Lightning and consumes the charges. Lose one per turn. Lightning-resistant targets do not take the flat +1 Lightning damage.
fields.Rush Attack: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Charge 30 ft and strike the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Strength save vs weapon-action DC prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Damage or Help ends it.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 avoids Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Standard successful attacks add 2 Piercing. Honour adds 2 of the incoming damage type even from sources without attack rolls. Healing ends it.
fields.Disarming Strike: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing against a creature holding a weapon. Strength save prevents dropping it. The base action lists weapon-action DC, while the applied condition lists DC +2. Damage still applies on a successful save.
fields.Acquisition: Choose as one of Florrick’s three rewards after rescuing her.
